text:
Eating out with a gluten, dairy, or nut allergy is a pain. So I made a free Grok Bot that remembers your allergies, finds safe orders at restaurants, checks labels, and plans easy meals at home. Try Allergy-Friendly Eats here 👇
https://x.ai/bot/uQhDO7G-zeHut15X_KHbe
(Always double-check with the restaurant.)
